statement: Per-client outbound GIP in pinned xone uses the live client's adapter to attach the corresponding wireless-client entry and select its data or audio queue before submission through shared receiver USB URBs. Client removal destroys that adapter. Neither absent-slot physical delivery behavior nor safe replay following uncertain USB delivery is established.

applicability.revision: Out-of-tree xone f2aa9fe01103d7600553b505b298ff0bd47ff280; Linux v7.3 or pinned SDL where cited
applicability.scope: transport/dongle.c:130-251, 561-591; bus/bus.c:187-209. Host source-routing semantics only, not proof of actual radio delivery or stateful retry safety.
